name: Chronomancer: The Vast Infinite shares 25% damage and heals it back at expiry (#1106)
contract: The Vast Infinite 706083 (Spell.dbc, family 28) reads 'All party and raid members become one, equally
sharing 25% of all damage dealt to them for $d, up to a maximum of 100% of their total health. At the
end of the duration, all affected allies are healed equal to the total damage shared split evenly
amongst all allies.' Both effects target TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID (100 yd,
SPELL_ATTR3_ONLY_ON_PLAYER) for DurationIndex 1 (10000 ms). Effect 0 is aura 69 with EffectBasePoints 25
(DieSides 0) and EffectMiscValueB 100: the 25% share and the 100%-of-maximum-health cap. The client
ships the two payloads: 707600 'The Vast Infinite [Damage]' ('Share damage.',
SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE) and 707601 'The Vast Infinite [Heal]' ('Share heal.', SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL),
both resolved-value helpers with SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS and
SPELL_ATTR4_IGNORE_DAMAGE_TAKEN_MODIFIERS. Before the fix the absorb was a flat 25-point shield and
nothing cast 707600 or 707601. Expected with two grouped players A (caster) and B: a fixed non-critical
Holy hit D on B (QA spell 45648 cast by a fixture) loses 25% of D to the shared pool, which is split
evenly, so A and B each take D/8 through 707600 (B also takes any odd remainder). A therefore loses
exactly its share, B loses 0.75 D + D/8 = 7 times A's share, B's own aura records the 0.25 D it absorbed
(twice A's share), and when the 10 sec expire each player is healed through 707601 for the shared damage
it took. The 100%-of-maximum-health cap is not exercised here. The original single NPC QA hit retained
its ordinary same-level Magic miss chance. Configure and assert the fixture NPC native spell hit bonus
at 100 percentage points. The original noncritical QA damage, two grouped holders and all quarter-share,
health-loss, absorbed-pool, no-early-healing and expiry-healing assertions remain. Unconfigured NPCs
retain their original hit modifier.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The grouped ally is linked by the same cast
One fixed, non-critical Holy hit on the ally
DISCRIMINATING: the caster takes a share of the ally's damage through 707600
The ally takes the same share (plus at most the odd remainder)
The ally's link recorded the 25% it absorbed: twice the caster's share
The caster lost exactly its share
The ally lost 75% of the hit plus its share, 7 times the caster's share
Nothing is healed back before the duration ends
At the end the caster is healed for the shared damage it took
At the end the ally is healed for the shared damage it took
The caster ends back at its starting health
The link expired on the ally
